protocol.spacing.title: Micro-Space
protocol.spacing.desc: THE INVISIBLE STRUCTURE. Most designers obsess over the shape of the letters. Engineers obsess over the space between them.
protocol.anatomy.title: Geometry
protocol.anatomy.desc: FUNCTION DICTATES FORM. Every curve in a Grotesk typeface has a reason. It is a machine made of vectors.
protocol.variable.title: Fluidity
protocol.variable.desc: STATIC IS DEAD. The web is a living medium. Typography must breathe.
protocol.grid.title: The Grid
protocol.grid.desc: ORDER FROM CHAOS. The baseline grid is the heartbeat of the page. Everything must align.
protocol.optical.title: Optical Truth
protocol.optical.desc: THE EYE LIES. Mathematical centers are not visual centers. We correct for the flaws of human perception.
protocol.scale.title: Hierarchy
protocol.scale.desc: SIZE IS RELATIVE. A modular scale creates harmony through mathematical ratios.
protocol.weight.title: Mass
protocol.weight.desc: GRAVITY ON THE PAGE. Weight changes the voice. Bold screams, light whispers.
protocol.tracking.title: Macro-Space
protocol.tracking.desc: BREATHING ROOM. As size decreases, spacing must increase. Readability depends on it.
protocol.alignment.title: Alignment
protocol.alignment.desc: THE AXIS OF POWER. Text alignment controls the flow of the eye. Ragged edges create organic rhythm.
protocol.glyph.title: Character Set
protocol.glyph.desc: THE COMPLETE SYSTEM. A typeface is a collection of thousands of glyphs working in unison.
protocol.mix.title: Synthesis
protocol.mix.desc: COMBINATORIAL LOGIC. Pairing typefaces creates tension and release.
